title: Beta-galactosidase activity assay for yeast
protocol: Collect approximately 5 × 107 cells from yeast cultures growing exponentially.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 4000xg at 4°C and wash once with water.
Resuspend cells in 200 μl of Z Buffer + β-mercaptoethanol (0.27% v/v) containing 1mg/mL zymolyase-20T.
Incubate samples for 20-30 minutes at 30°C to digest cells.
Centrifuge the mixture at 13400xg for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a new eppendorf tube.
Use 1 or 2 μL of the extract to quantify protein amount using the Bradford assay.
Mix 180 μl of extract with 700 μL of Z Buffer + β-mercaptoethanol.
Start the reaction by adding 200 μL of 4mg/mL ONPG (o-nitrophenyl-β-D-galactopyranoside).
Incubate samples at 30°C until they turn yellow (up to 90 minutes).
When a yellow color appears, stop the reaction with 500 μL of Na2CO3 1M.
Centrifuge cells at 13400xg for 1 minute to pellet cells.
Express β-galactosidase activity in arbitrary units (U) using the formula: U = (A460 × 1000)/(Time (min) × Volume (μL) × Concentration (μg/μL)).
